source.note: This file is the Godot-readable view of an external authority, not a second authority. The rules themselves are distributed in this repository at vendor/d10srd/ under their own licence, and tests/d10srd-conformance.test.mjs executes them. That test also asserts this file's rules_id and srd_version match vendor/d10srd/PROVENANCE.json, so the two sides cannot be re-pinned independently.

vendored_authority.note: Before the rules were distributed here, the only conformance check was a transcription of the numbers into a test, which could keep passing while the published rules moved. This closed that gap: the rules run, and the digests make an out-of-band edit a build failure.

srd_controls: the check equation and its integer domains
authority_boundary.quote: This is difficulty/check scaling. Do not divide health, damage, movement, range, time, capacity, currency, ammunition, action counts, or unrelated economies unless a named module explicitly says so.
authority_boundary.consequence: Authored balance numbers -- weapon damage, movement costs, block reduction, unit HP -- are NOT d10SRD conformance surface. Pinning them under a conformance label makes a legitimate balance change read as a rules violation. They belong in a balance-baseline test instead.

vectors.requirement: reproduce the published ability table, including 4-5 => -2
vectors.reason: The Godot port implements no ability-score check resolution, so there is nothing here to conform. Verified by absence: no check-resolution symbol may appear in the port's configuration authority. The vector itself is exercised against the vendored rules by tests/d10srd-conformance.test.mjs, so it is covered at the ecosystem level rather than merely excused here.
The Godot port implements no difficulty class, so there is nothing here to conform. Verified by absence. The vector is exercised against the vendored rules by tests/d10srd-conformance.test.mjs.

vectors.requirement: require a 6+ confirmation for natural 1 and natural 10 threats
vectors.reason: The Godot port implements no threat confirmation, so there is nothing here to conform. Verified by absence. The vector is exercised against the vendored rules by tests/d10srd-conformance.test.mjs.

Godot 'skills' are equipment and capability tags, not ranked check inputs, so there is nothing here to conform. Verified by absence of a rank field. The vector is exercised against the vendored rules by tests/d10srd-conformance.test.mjs.

vectors.requirement: keep the tactical AP maximum at 10
keep setting and transport authority outside this core
vectors.reason: Governance constraint on the SRD, not a value the port can assert. The port satisfies it by consuming the SRD rather than redefining it. tests/d10srd-conformance.test.mjs asserts the sentence stating the boundary is still present in the vendored document, so the boundary cannot quietly disappear.

forbidden_symbols_note: If any of these appear in the Godot configuration authority, the port has begun implementing check resolution and vectors 1-4 stop being not-applicable. The conformance test fails closed on their presence so the 'not applicable' declarations above can never quietly become false.
